title: How to write a CV with no work experience (NZ)
desc: No work experience yet? How to write a New Zealand CV that still gets interviews: school, volunteering, part-time work and transferable skills.
blocks: Everyone starts somewhere. Employers hiring for entry-level, part-time and holiday jobs know you will not have years of experience. Show that you are reliable and keen to learn.
List your school or study, NCEA level and any subjects or achievements that relate to the job.
Volunteering, for example at a sports club, marae or community event
Babysitting, lawn mowing, helping in a family business
School roles: prefect, team captain, club member
Personal projects you are proud of
Teamwork, communication, time management and customer service matter in almost every job. Give a short example for each.
With little experience, one or two clear pages is better than a long, thin CV. CVLibre lets you describe your background in a few lines and the AI fills in the form.
